deliverables.description: A cleaned, transformed, and organized dataset stored in a queryable format suitable for analysis of system capabilities and requirements.
A written summary describing system capabilities and requirements as evidenced by the manipulated data, including key findings derived from the analysis.

information_nodes.description: Raw operational or performance data from the system under assessment, provided in a structured or semi-structured format for storage and manipulation.
information_nodes.modality_rationale: System operational data such as metrics, logs, or configuration records are naturally represented in tabular form for storage and retrieval.

information_nodes.description: Definition of which system capabilities and requirements are to be analyzed, including relevant data fields, time ranges, and evaluation criteria.
information_nodes.modality_rationale: Scope and criteria are textual instructions specifying what the worker must assess.

information_nodes.description: Schema or structure description of the raw system data, including field names, data types, and relationships, needed to store and retrieve data correctly.
information_nodes.modality_rationale: A schema description is textual metadata required to correctly interpret, store, and query the raw data.

information_nodes.description: The raw data after it has been loaded into a storage mechanism, making it retrievable for subsequent manipulation and analysis.
The subset of stored data retrieved according to the analysis scope, isolating the records and fields relevant to the capability assessment.
The retrieved data after manipulation—such as filtering, aggregation, normalization, or calculation of derived metrics—producing a dataset ready for analysis.
Conclusions about system capabilities and requirements drawn from evidence in the transformed data, identifying performance characteristics, limitations, or compliance with stated requirements.

work_objective: Store, retrieve, and manipulate operational data so that system capabilities and requirements can be analyzed, producing a structured dataset and a capability assessment summary.

deliverables.description: A structured design level document containing defined game mechanics, design guidelines, and mission outlines, written for use by the development team.

information_nodes.description: High-level description of the game's genre, theme, target platform, and intended player experience.
information_nodes.modality_rationale: A text brief is the standard format for communicating the foundational concept and scope of a game project to a designer.

information_nodes.description: Any prior or related design documents, feature lists, or narrative outlines that the new level documentation must align with or extend.
information_nodes.modality_rationale: Prior design artifacts may include text specifications and structural diagrams that the designer must reference for consistency.

information_nodes.description: A clear articulation of the core gameplay mechanics—player actions, rules, and systems—that operate within the levels being documented.
Standards and constraints governing level construction, including pacing, difficulty progression, and interaction principles.
Structured descriptions of level missions, including objectives, sequence of events, and success/failure conditions.
Assessment that the defined mechanics and mission structures are consistent with the established design guidelines and the overall game concept.

modality_hypotheses.information_needed: Structural relationships between game systems, level flow, or mission progression as depicted in prior design artifacts.
modality_hypotheses.modality_rationale: Game design documents frequently use flowcharts or diagrams to represent system interactions and level progression, which the designer must interpret to ensure new documentation is consistent.

work_objective: Develop and maintain design level documentation for a video game, specifying gameplay mechanics, design guidelines, and mission outlines in a structured, reference-ready format.
